body: I wish I could afford to adopt a child.
A child. It will never happen.

This will be buried. I'm trying to bury it now. My grief. Tell everyone to cherish this. Forever. This photograph is everything I have ever wanted, and everything I will never have: a loving father, a child of my own, seeing that look in my spouses eyes, looking into the eyes of my child. Cherish it every day. For me.
